description_en: Queries the number of successful connections, the number of failed connections, the success rate, and the average connection duration within a specified time range
description_zh: 查询指定时间范围内的连接成功数、失败数、成功率和平均连接耗时
kebab_example: aliyun appstream-center query-connection-report --app-instance-group-id 'aig-9ciijz60n4xsv****' --page-size 100 --page-number 1 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --start-date '2026-09-01 00:00:00' --end-date '2026-09-02 00:00:00' --product-type CloudApp --api-version 2021-09-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryConnectionReport

parameters.help_en: The ID of the app instance group, which is used to filter data for a specified app instance group. You can call [ListAppInstanceGroup](~~ListAppInstanceGroup~~) to obtain the ID. If you do not specify this parameter, data is not filtered by app instance group
parameters.help_zh: 交付组 ID，用于筛选指定交付组的数据。可调用 [ListAppInstanceGroup](~~ListAppInstanceGroup~~) 获取；不传时不按交付组筛选
parameters.name: app_instance_group_id

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 200. If the value exceeds 1,500, it is processed as 1,500
parameters.help_zh: 每页记录数。不传时默认 200；大于 1500 时按 1500 处理
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number to query. We recommend that you explicitly specify a value starting from `1`. If you do not specify this parameter, the service processes the request as the first page, but the response may echo `0`
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的页码。建议从 `1` 开始显式传入；不传时服务按首页处理，但响应可能回显 `0`
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The ID of the business region, which is used to filter report data. You can call [ListRegions](~~ListRegions~~) to obtain the ID
parameters.help_zh: 业务地域 ID，用于筛选报表数据。可调用 [ListRegions](~~ListRegions~~) 获取
parameters.name: biz_region_id

parameters.help_en: The start time of the statistics. Required. Format: `yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss`. The statistical interval includes the start time but excludes the end time. The time span cannot exceed 60 months. The string itself does not carry a time zone and is interpreted in the Asia/Shanghai (UTC+8) time zone
parameters.help_zh: 统计开始时间，必填。格式：`yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss`。统计区间包含开始时间、不包含结束时间。时间跨度不能超过 60 个月。字符串本身不携带时区，按 Asia/Shanghai（UTC+8）解释
parameters.name: start_date

parameters.help_en: The end time of the statistics. Required. Format: `yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss`. The value cannot be earlier than `StartDate`. The statistical interval includes the start time but excludes the end time. The time span cannot exceed 60 months. The string itself does not carry a time zone and is interpreted in the Asia/Shanghai (UTC+8) time zone
parameters.help_zh: 统计结束时间，必填。格式：`yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss`，且不能早于 `StartDate`。统计区间包含开始时间、不包含结束时间。时间跨度不能超过 60 个月。字符串本身不携带时区，按 Asia/Shanghai（UTC+8）解释
parameters.name: end_date

parameters.help_en:
The product type. Required.

Valid values:

`CloudApp`: Wuying cloud app.
`CloudBrowser`: Cloud browser.
`WuyingServer`: Enterprise edition workstation.
`WuyingWorkstation`: Personal edition Linggou container workstation.
`WuyingWorkstationTeam`: Team edition Linggou container workstation.
`WuyingWorkstationBusiness`: Dedicated edition Linggou container workstation.
`AndroidCloud`: Cloud phone.
`AIAgent`: AgentBay (AI agent)
parameters.help_zh:
产品类型。必填。

取值：

`CloudApp`：无影云应用。
`CloudBrowser`：云浏览器。
`WuyingServer`：企业版工作站。
`WuyingWorkstation`：个人版灵构容器工作站。
`WuyingWorkstationTeam`：灵构团队版容器工作站。
`WuyingWorkstationBusiness`：灵构专属版容器工作站。
`AndroidCloud`：云手机。
`AIAgent`：AgentBay（AI 智能体）
parameters.name: product_type

Code.description_en: The business status code. `200` indicates that the request is successful. Other values indicate that the request failed
Code.description_zh: 业务状态码。`200` 表示请求处理成功；其他值表示处理失败

ConnectionReportDataModel.description_en: The list of connection report data

AppInstanceGroupId.description_en: The ID of the app instance group

ConnectionAvgDurationSeconds.description_en: The average duration of successful connections. In the current version, the return value is in milliseconds, so parse it as milliseconds. The `Seconds` in the field name is retained for compatibility and does not indicate the unit. This value may not be returned if there are no successful connections
ConnectionAvgDurationSeconds.description_zh: 成功连接的平均耗时。当前版本返回值单位为毫秒，请按毫秒解析；字段名中的 `Seconds` 为兼容保留，不能作为单位依据。没有成功连接时可能不返回该值

ConnectionFailureCount.description_en: The number of connection failures within the statistical window
ConnectionFailureCount.description_zh: 统计窗口内连接失败的次数。单位：次

ConnectionSuccessCount.description_en: The number of successful connections within the statistical window
ConnectionSuccessCount.description_zh: 统计窗口内连接成功的次数。单位：次

ConnectionSuccessRate.description_en: The connection success rate, which is calculated by dividing the number of successful connections by the sum of successful and failed connections. The value ranges from 0 to 1. Multiply the value by 100 to get the percentage. This value may not be returned if there are no connection records
ConnectionSuccessRate.description_zh: 连接成功率，计算方式为成功次数除以成功与失败次数之和，取值范围为 0～1；如需百分比请乘以 100。无连接记录时可能不返回该值

RegionId.description_en: The ID of the business region to which the report data belongs
RegionId.description_zh: 报表数据所属的业务地域 ID

StatEndDate.description_en: The end time of the statistical window. Format: `yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss`. The string itself does not carry a time zone and is interpreted in the Asia/Shanghai (UTC+8) time zone
StatEndDate.description_zh: 统计窗口结束时间，格式：`yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss`。字符串本身不携带时区，按 Asia/Shanghai（UTC+8）解释

StatStartDate.description_en: The start time of the statistical window. Format: `yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss`. The string itself does not carry a time zone and is interpreted in the Asia/Shanghai (UTC+8) time zone
StatStartDate.description_zh: 统计窗口开始时间，格式：`yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss`。字符串本身不携带时区，按 Asia/Shanghai（UTC+8）解释

Count.description_en: The total number of records that meet the query conditions
Count.description_zh: 满足查询条件的记录总数

Message.description_en: The description of the request processing result. `success` is usually returned when the request is successful
Message.description_zh: 请求处理结果说明。请求成功时通常返回 `success`

PageNumber.description_en: The page number corresponding to the current response

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page used in the current response
PageSize.description_zh: 本次响应采用的每页记录数

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier of the current request, which can be used to troubleshoot the request
RequestId.description_zh: 本次请求的唯一标识，可用于定位请求问题
